name: Solidarity Bank
note: Samara-based commercial bank (АО КБ «Солидарность»). Its logo will be on Krylia Sovetov's 2026/27 playing kit (club announcement, 2026-07-20) and the club's home stadium is named 'Солидарность Самара Арена'. Current owners not traced: the bank was controlled by the family of ex-governor Konstantin Titov until 2014 and then went through a 'Life' financial-group sanitisation (ru.wikipedia/Letopis summaries only; the bank publishes shareholder disclosures via Interfax-ЦРКИ, not opened).
